newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Sfakianakis to start trade June 18.
newsitem.headline: Greek Sfakianakis to start trade June 18.

text.p: Greek automobile dealer Sfakianakis AEBE will make its trading debut on the bourse's main market on June 18.
No daily volatility limit will be applied to Sfakianakis shares during the first three days of trading.
Sfakianakis went public at 2,000 drachmas a share and its IPO was subscribed 7.38 times.
The IPO tranche allocated to institutional investors was oversubscribed 9.5 times with 120 subscriptions while the retail portion was oversubscribed 6.4 times with 2,409 subscriptions.
It tapped the market for 4.25 billion drachmas with an issue of 2,125,000 common bearer shares with a par value of 300 drachmas.
IPO proceeds will be used as working capital and will finance the completion of new facilities.
In the first four months of 1997, Sfakianakis turned in pretax profits of 1.6 billion drachmas on turnover of 12.3 billion.
Over the same period, Sfakianakis increased its market share by 0.2 percentage points to 5.6 year-on-year, with car sales improving to 3,063 units from 2,803 in the January-April 1996 period.
In fiscal 1996, pretax earnings rose 58 percent to 3.784 billion drachmas on turnover growth of 31 percent to 32.7 billion drachmas.
